rationale: Round-2 repo-grounding audit at reviewed commit 8a13b898 (spec.md-only delta over the round-1 base, so all prior code verifications carry). ROUND-1 ASK CLASSIFICATION: ask 1 (ADR-0023:142 -> :140) is ADDRESSED in all four original locations (Background staleness paragraph, ADR Touchpoints, OQ-4, grill record) but the fix simultaneously introduced one NEW wrong :142 citation (see NEW_ISSUE finding); ask 2 (select.go:97 -> :92) is ADDRESSED (Background residue #2 now cites select.go:92, which is exact). NEW CLAIMS RE-DERIVED: the G1 discriminator mechanism is correct and I reproduced all three shapes empirically 2026-09-01: (i) main checkout, healthy bd -> {"mode":"idle"} exit 0; (ii) main checkout, bd unreachable via stripped PATH with the binary invoked absolutely -> {"mode":""} exit 0; (iii) spec worktree under BOTH bd conditions -> idle-with-activeSpec, confirming the ''-shape is unreachable from a worktree. The mechanism sentence checks against code: state.go:60-77's ResolveTarget-error fallback serializes ctx.Phase; derive.go:588-597's WorktreeMain arms are both err==nil-guarded so a discovery error leaves Phase empty; the function returns (ctx, nil) at :600; resolve.go:59-60 collapses a bd failure to ModeIdle on the worktree path, matching the observed idle-with-activeSpec under blocked bd. However the spec's WRITTEN reproduction line 'env PATH=/usr/bin:/bin mindspec state show' does NOT run as written - it exits 127 ('env: mindspec: No such file or directory') because mindspec itself lives at /Users/Max/.local/bin, which the stripped PATH removes; only the absolute-binary form reproduces the {"mode":""} capture (see finding). Other new citations all verify exactly: artifactPaths one-entry list at internal/next/guard.go:24-26; .mindspec/session.json gitignored at .gitignore:3; the claim step's BeadClaimedAt stamp + state.WriteSessionFile at cmd/mindspec/next.go:313-314; repairMergeMetadataFn seam at repair.go:28; repair phase's 'Phase for %s repaired: %q -> %q' / 'already consistent' result lines within repair.go:199-205; release's claim-reversal summary ('Released bead X / Worktree removed; bead returned to open') at release.go:321; SelectWork's single-item early return at select.go:20-22 which does bypass pick validation exactly as R6.1/AC-9 claim; derive.go:193 'return storedPhase, nil' supporting the R1.3 carve-out's stored-is-authoritative claim; ADR-0025 decision item 5 verbatim at ADR-0025.md:36 ('Today it contains one entry: .beads/issues.jsonl', 'The list is not a glob'); ADR-0041's Reconcile 'Never a rollback' (:105) and section-2 forward-reconcile (:144) supporting the G3.2 repricing of OQ-1(b) as a reversal. The G8 empty-enumeration claim is supported by what the tree shows (session.json gitignored, issues.jsonl the sole exempt artifact, worktree creation sited after the step-1 guard), and AC-8(ii) pins the enumeration by test rather than by assertion. One NEW citation defect found: R1.3's release row cites ADR-0023.md:142 for the all-open->plan row, but that row is at :141 (:142 is a blank line; :140 some-closed->implement, :141 all-open->plan), and the grill record's corrected note repeats the error by calling :142 'the amendment's all-open row'. Both defects are cosmetic line offsets that change no behavioral conclusion; the document's grounding is otherwise the strongest I have audited here two rounds running.

findings.title: G1 reproduction line not runnable verbatim - env strips the path mindspec itself lives on
findings.detail: Executed from the main checkout: `env PATH=/usr/bin:/bin mindspec state show` -> 'env: mindspec: No such file or directory', exit 127, because env performs its own PATH lookup for mindspec and /Users/Max/.local/bin is stripped. `env PATH=/usr/bin:/bin /Users/Max/.local/bin/mindspec state show` -> {"mode": ""} exit 0, exactly the pinned capture. The discriminator claim (bd availability, not environment nondeterminism, selects between the idle and empty shapes) is therefore TRUE and verified - only the written invocation is imprecise. Since AC-1(ii) and a Validation Proofs line pin this exact command as the red-on-revert counterexample, the line should be written in a form that actually runs.
